title: Precision Concrete Pumping
description: precisionconcretepump.com zoominfo.com/c/precision-concrete-pumping-inc/356699459 Precision Concrete Pumping, Inc. is an MBE-certified concrete pumping company established in 1988, with branches across New York and New Jersey. The company specializes in providing high-quality concrete pumping services, including boom pumps, line pumps, and telebelts, utilizing a modern fleet of Putzmeister and Schwing equipment. With over 25 years of experience, they serve commercial, industrial, and municipal projects throughout the Northeast, ensuring reliable performance and exceptional customer service
